title: Smoking, tar, and cancer front-door model
content: An unobserved Smoking Gene confounds Smoking and Cancer, while Tar is a shielded mediator carrying every directed effect of Smoking on Cancer. Tar therefore satisfies the front-door criterion.

variables.name: Smoking Gene
variables.content: The unobserved common cause of Smoking and Cancer.

variables.name: Smoking
variables.content: The treatment whose causal effect on Cancer is sought.

variables.name: Tar
variables.content: The shielded mediator between Smoking and Cancer.
